raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 27
Reason for Mistake: After formulating a correct revised plan that highlighted targeting FTP directories (specifically Ensembl’s FTP where release-101 GFF3 files reside), the Orchestrator immediately reverted to instructing generic NCBI browsing instead of directing WebSurfer to Ensembl’s FTP. This misdirection caused the search to drift toward irrelevant pages (NCBI GDV) and culminated in the wrong final link, rather than the correct Ensembl FTP GFF3 link current on 20/10/2020.
